company.name: Dyno Therapeutics
company.shortDescription: Dyno Therapeutics is a biotechnology company that uses artificial intelligence for gene therapy.
company.description: Dyno Therapeutics is pioneering an artificial intelligence (AI) powered approach to gene therapy. Using machine learning and quantitative high-throughput in vivo experimentation, we are inventing new ways to design gene vectors with a focus on cell-targeting capsid proteins from adeno-associated virus (AAV), the most widely-used vector for gene therapies.

aiResearchSummary.text: Dyno Therapeutics is engaged in research and development of dependoparvovirus and variant capsid polypeptides, as described in titles such as Capsid polypeptides and methods of use thereof and Capsid variants and methods of using the same. These innovations focus on delivering payloads, including targeted delivery to the eye for treating trabecular meshwork disorders. Additionally, systems and methods for predicting features of biological sequences using statistical and machine learning models are being developed. These areas define Dyno Therapeutics’ R&D focus.

insights.title: Hybrid therapeutic platform
insights.statement: Dyno Therapeutics combines Dyno Psi-Phi with Dyno AI-Powered Gene Delivery Platform.
insights.implication: The company is positioned as a biotechnology platform with both a physical therapeutic-delivery modality and an AI-assisted discovery layer, rather than as a standalone AI software vendor.
caveats: Product descriptions are profile claims and do not establish clinical efficacy.
